title: Bharat Electronics receives additional orders worth ₹648 crore since August 26
description: Bharat Electronics Ltd (BEL) has secured additional orders worth ₹648 crore since its last disclosure on August 26, 2026. title: AIIMS Delhi transfers AI-based mammography interpretation technology to BPL Technologies Limited
description: AIIMS New Delhi has transferred technology for an Artificial Intelligence-based mammography interpretation model developed at the institute to BPL Technologies Limited. The technology transfer, held on September 16, marks an industry-academia collaboration aimed at supporting further development, validation and potential implementation of the model to assist radiologists, particularly in areas with limited access to breast imaging specialists.
